items.summary: Risk disposition: blocked for public beta, full launch, affiliate/advertising expansion, public Woot-data display, and alert expansion. Recommendation: keep searchwoot.com private and leave rights outreach unsent pending owner authorization and human counsel review. Evidence: Woot documentation establishes API access but not redistribution rights; current public terms restrict commercial/public use of listings, descriptions, and prices. Security, accuracy/freshness, measurement, compliance, and owner gates also remain incomplete. Ordinary reversible fleet growth may continue only when it adds no credentials, permissions, dependencies, data collection, or cross-site behavior.

Launch-readiness tracking remains active. Progress: 0 of 4 legal tasks can close. Source-rights evidence is documented but confirms access only, not permission; data-flow evidence is partial; consent/analytics evidence is partial; logs, vendor, and incident evidence remain open. Do not mark any task complete. Next evidence action: attach one dated read-only bundle containing the repository/config data-flow table, deployed consent capture, GA4 property/data-sharing and retention settings, log-field/retention inventory, vendor terms/DPA status, and incident/request procedures.

items.title: Maintain SearchWoot private launch gate and complete evidence bundle
items.summary: Keep searchwoot.com private because Woot rights, data-use permissions, privacy evidence, security evidence, accuracy/freshness, measurement, and owner disposition remain incomplete. This is risk triage, not legal advice or certification.
items.requested_action: Continue the four existing launch-readiness legal tasks through read-only evidence capture. Do not send Woot outreach, enable tracking, expand alerts, publish Woot data, add affiliate or advertising use, deploy, or change the private gate without owner authorization and human counsel review.
